item.title: New UMC EMS station coming to south Lubbock
item.description: A new EMS station will be built in south Lubbock starting March 1, 2026, to better serve the growing population and reduce response times, with the project costing $1.6 million and completion expected in April 2027.

item.title: Winter weather leaving potholes on local roads
item.description: The City of Lubbock's Street Maintenance office has patched 240 potholes since late January, and citizens are encouraged to report any potholes through the "MyLBK" app or by calling the Streets Maintenance office.

item.title: Rewards offered as search for Savannah Guthrie's mother continues: Here's the latest
item.description: Law enforcement officials are still desperately searching for leads in the investigation into the disappearance of 84-year-old Nancy Guthrie, the mother of NBC News's “Today” show co-anchor Savannah Guthrie.

item.title: Death investigation underway in West Lubbock on Wednesday morning
item.description: LUBBOCK, Texas -- The Lubbock Metropolitan Special Crimes Unit announced Wednesday morning the unit is currently on scene in the 5700 block of 50th street. LPD said they are conducting a death investigation. This is a developing story check EverythingLubbock.com for more information.
